findings.title: Module-boundary architecture test runs at 85-92% of vitest's default 5 s timeout and times out under moderate CPU load (flaky required unit check)
findings.reproduction: apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts:107 ('every import respects dependsOn, public surfaces and allowed packages') runs in the unit-node project, which sets no testTimeout (vitest.config.ts sets 30_000 only for the integration project), so the default 5000 ms applies. Disposable clone at eb8163e2, Node v22.22.2, `pnpm test`. While a second disposable clone was building and running integration probes on the same host, it took 5829 ms and FAILED with 'Test timed out in 5000ms' (unit-node22.log, 1 failed / 491 passed, exit 1). Re-run twice with no concurrent load, it took 4558 ms and 4322 ms, PASS 492/492 (unit-node22-rerun1.log, unit-node22-rerun2.log). Any slower or shared CI runner can turn the required `pnpm test` check red without a code change.
findings.expected: A required gate check is deterministic: the AST-walking architecture test has an explicit timeout that leaves headroom (for example 30 s, like the integration project), or is made faster.
findings.actual: 4.3-4.6 s of a 5 s budget without load; 5.8 s and a timeout failure under moderate load.
